title: Newmark Arranges $20 Million Sale of Liberty Corners, a Grocery-Anchored Retail Center in Kansas City
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the approximately $20 million sale of Liberty Corners, a 125,000-square-foot grocery-anchored retail center in the Kansas City suburb of Liberty, Missouri.
body_markdown: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the approximately $20 million sale of Liberty Corners, a 125,000-square-foot grocery-anchored retail center in the Kansas City suburb of Liberty, Missouri.
